title: In This World Your Palm Shows Your Best Friends
description: Your palm shows how many people call you their best friend, and Yuto's has said zero for sixteen years. Who would make your number go up? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Yuto: 16-year-old Japanese boy, short messy black hair, quiet tired eyes, dark navy gakuran school uniform with gold buttons, white undershirt, black trousers, black school shoes, worn black canvas shoulder bag, no hat, no glasses
characters.Hina: 16-year-old Japanese girl, straight shoulder-length black hair with a small red hair clip, navy sailor school uniform with a red neckerchief, navy pleated skirt, beige duffle coat over it, white socks, brown loafers, no hat, no glasses
characters.Akari: 16-year-old Japanese girl, long brown hair in a high ponytail, bright smile, navy sailor school uniform with a red neckerchief, navy pleated skirt, white socks, brown loafers, no hat

scenes.say: In this world, your palm shows how many people call you their best friend. Akari's says thirty one. Yuto is sixteen, and his has always said zero.
scenes.video: [0-4s] In a 1990s Japanese high school hallway with a wooden floor and tall windows, Akari laughs with an open palm raised, one small softly glowing number on her palm. [4-7s] Close-up of Yuto sitting at his wooden desk by the classroom window, slowly closing his hand into a fist. [7-10s] Medium shot of Yuto walking alone down an empty school corridor at dusk, bag on his shoulder.

scenes.say: So every morning he waits alone at the old wooden bus stop. Except one girl, Hina, waits there too. She always keeps her left hand in her pocket.
scenes.video: [0-4s] A small old wooden bus shelter beside a quiet country road lined with rice fields in early morning mist, Yuto sitting alone on its bench. [4-7s] Medium shot inside the wooden bus shelter: Hina stands at the far end of the bench, left hand deep in her duffle coat pocket. [7-10s] Close-up of Hina inside the bus shelter glancing sideways at Yuto, then looking down at the road.

scenes.say: But they never talk. When it rains, he holds his umbrella over both of them. She tears her melon bread in half for him. Two hundred mornings like that.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Rain pours on the rice fields as Yuto silently tilts a plain black umbrella over Hina beside the wooden bus shelter. [4-7s] Close-up inside the bus shelter: Hina tears a round melon bread in half and holds one half out to Yuto without looking at him. [7-10s] Medium shot of the two sitting on the wooden bench chewing in silence, rain dripping off the shelter roof.

scenes.say: Then one rainy morning, Hina doesn't come. Yuto lets his bus go. Then the next one. He waits forty minutes, worried sick, and misses first period.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Yuto stands alone inside the wooden bus shelter in the rain, staring at Hina's empty end of the bench. [4-7s] Medium shot: a plain cream-colored country bus pulls away down the wet road while Yuto stays standing under the shelter. [7-10s] Close-up of Yuto in the bus shelter, rain behind him, biting his lip and looking down the empty road.

scenes.say: Next morning Hina's back with a cold. She finally pulls her left hand out. Her zero became a one yesterday at 8:10, the exact minute Yuto let his bus go.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Misty morning at the wooden bus shelter: Hina sits on the bench with a red nose and a scarf, Yuto stopping in surprise at the entrance. [4-7s] Close-up inside the bus shelter of Hina slowly drawing her left hand out of her coat pocket and opening it, one small softly glowing number on her palm. [7-10s] Close-up of Hina's shy face, eyes wet, looking up at Yuto.

scenes.say: Yuto hasn't checked his own palm in years. He opens it. One, since last night. In this world, your palm shows who calls you their best friend. Theirs both say one.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Close-up inside the wooden bus shelter of Yuto's fist slowly opening, one small softly glowing number on his palm. [4-7s] Medium shot of Yuto and Hina on the bench, open palms side by side, both starting to laugh. [7-10s] Wide quiet shot of the two sitting close together inside the little wooden bus shelter beside the misty rice fields as morning sun breaks through.
